name: GET /api/leadflow/digests - reviews and the state of their outputs
description:
Generated digests with their REQUIRED OUTPUTS attached (3070e925-615d-429e-8209-1568671c3502#AC1). The difference between a reminder and a rhythm is the output: "send the 11:30 sweep" is a notification people learn to skim, while "the 11:30 sweep produces reassignments, capacity fixes and coaching moments, and somebody is accountable for each" is the SOP. The outputs are returned WITH the digest rather than behind a second call, because the question anybody opening this screen asks is "what came out of yesterday's sweeps".

NINE REVIEWS ON THE AMERICA/CHICAGO CALENDAR (3070e925-615d-429e-8209-1568671c3502#AC2), each with a local time that is a NAMED ZONE rather than an offset - Chicago moves twice a year and a fixed -05:00 puts the launch huddle at 7:45 for half of it, which is the kind of bug that gets blamed on people not showing up.

EVERY DIGEST CARRIES ITS TEMPLATE KEY AND VERSION (3070e925-615d-429e-8209-1568671c3502#AC4). A template that changes silently makes last month's pack unreadable against this month's - the sections move and the archive still claims to be the same document.

QA: measured live; five daily rhythms generated with 8 tracked outputs between them.

testCases.name: Digests are returned with their outputs, template versions and the named zone
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: rhythm_key must be one of overnight_queue, launch_huddle, sla_sweep, late_day_sweep, next_action_sweep, weekly_funnel, weekly_coaching, weekly_winloss, monthly_postmortem
errorCases.when: a rhythm_key filter is supplied that is not one of the nine reviews.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
